---
title: Agnolotti with Black Truffle
id: MAR-0128
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 50
difficulty: hard
---
## Ingredients
- 350 g egg pasta
- 350 g veal
- 100 g prosciutto crudo
- 80 g Grana Padano
- 60 g butter
- 1 black truffle
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Finely chop the veal with the prosciutto and 40 g of truffle and collect everything in a bowl, add 40 g of Grana Padano and mix until homogeneous.
2. Cover the bowl with a cloth and let rest in a cool place.
3. Roll out the egg pasta into two thin sheets, on one place the filling in balls spaced 5 cm apart, cover with the second sheet and cut out the agnolotti using a fluted wheel.
4. Bring abundant salted water to a boil and cook the agnolotti; melt the butter; drain the agnolotti, pour them into a serving bowl alternating with the remaining Grana Padano and the butter, mix, distribute on plates and finish with the remaining truffle cut into thin slices.
